description.en: Third-party DSH bundle carrying the original deterministic-pixel-art Skill for editable JSON/PNG pixel art, Python rendering and recoloring within declared regions. For DSH core/Skill 0.2.2-rc.1; requires Python 3.10+ and Pillow >=10.4,<13.
description.zh: 第三方 DSH bundle，携带原 deterministic-pixel-art Skill，支持可编辑 JSON/PNG 像素画、Python 渲染及声明区域内的改色。适用于 DSH core/Skill 0.2.2-rc.1；需要 Python 3.10+ 和 Pillow >=10.4,<13。
